people.name: Bill Jiao
people.title: CEO
people.bio_text: Bill Jiao (Zhandong Jiao) is the CEO and co-founder of General Instinct (YC P26), a company built alongside a longtime collaborator from their shared ML vision research days. He has demonstrated deep interest in LLM efficiency, real-time AI perception, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning. Bill is an early-stage founder in the YC P26 batch, operating at the intersection of applied ML research and product.

people.name: Micah Stubbs
people.title: Founder
people.bio_text: Micah Stubbs is a Silicon Valley-based founder and data visualization practitioner with a PhD in Data Visualization and deep roots in the d3.js open source community. He specializes in building visual intuition for machine learning, graph data, and WebXR interfaces, and is currently founding IntentiveAI. His background spans AI tooling (H2O.ai), Lightning Network payments (lightpay), and over 746 public GitHub repos reflecting broad experimentation across JS, Python, and emerging design spaces.

people.name: mufaddal.esmael@gmail.com
people.title: Principal Software Engineer
people.bio_text: Mufaddal Esmael is a Principal Software Engineer specializing in embedded systems, connectivity, and charging software for electric vehicles, most recently at LiveWire (a Harley-Davidson subsidiary). He brings deep expertise spanning embedded Linux, Bluetooth, OTA update architecture, and automotive-grade software delivery across a career that includes Aeris Communications, Earlens, Volkswagen, Visteon, and legacy automotive OEMs. He is based in the Greater St. Louis / Mountain View area and is self-described as currently independent.

people.name: Konstantin
people.title: Cofounder & CEO
people.bio_text: Konstantin Baumer is the Cofounder & CEO of DreamInk, a company operating in the brand entertainment and product placement space. Based in Bavaria, Germany, he studied at IE University. Insufficient public signal was available to characterize his technical background or prior ventures.

people.name: Artem Yatsenko
people.title: Machine Learning Engineer
people.bio_text: Artem Yatsenko is a Machine Learning Engineer at Osmosis with a background in ML systems and open-source LLM research, previously at Nous Research. He is a hands-on builder focused on efficient inference and transformer architectures, with notable open-source projects including loopvlm (real-time VLM inference) and several PyTorch/MLX model implementations spanning vision-language models, transformers, and hyperparameter optimization.

people.name: Steven Enamakel
people.title: Founder
people.bio_text: Steven Enamakel is a serial DeFi founder turned AI builder, best known for creating MahaDAO (ARTH stablecoin) and now building TinyHumans AI — an open-source personal AI agent powered by brain-inspired memory systems. He is a hands-on technical founder with deep roots in DeFi protocol design, smart contract security, and TypeScript/Rust engineering, currently pivoting toward consumer AI products that are private, local, and UI-first.

people.name: David Chen
people.title: GM, Robotics
people.bio_text: David Chen is GM of Robotics at LiveKit, where he is building foundational real-time infrastructure for the next generation of robotics. He brings nearly a decade of experience as Head of R&D and CTO at Skycatch (autonomous drones for mining/construction) and as Head of Software Services at Agtonomy (autonomous tractors for agriculture), giving him rare end-to-end perspective on shipping autonomous systems in the physical world. His conviction is that production robotics requires purpose-built real-time comms and observability infrastructure — the gap he is now building into LiveKit.

people.name: Joseph Zheng
people.title: N/A
people.bio_text: Joseph Zheng is an early-career technologist with prior experience at Nupeak Robotics, an agricultural robotics startup building autonomous fruit-picking robots, and Adelpha Tech. Limited public signal is available from X or LinkedIn to characterize his specific focus or current projects.

people.name: Luke Bechtel
people.title: Founding Engineer
people.bio_text: Luke Bechtel is a full-stack founding engineer and creative technologist based in San Francisco, with a background spanning industrial automation, neural network research, and 3D printing. He founded Reasonote (On Deck Founders cohort ODF22), an AI-powered adaptive learning platform, and now serves as Founding Engineer at Infinity AI Institute, a YC-backed generative video company building a script-to-movie foundation model. He is drawn to positive-sum games, improv, music, and storytelling, and channels that curiosity into building educational and creative AI tools.

people.name: Shirley Li
people.title: Researcher
people.bio_text: Shirley Mingye Li is a researcher at the Chinese Academy of Sciences (Ickylin Group) and a current CMU graduate student (class of 2026) with a background from UVA, based in Santa Clara. She has interned as a PM at Zoom and builds side projects spanning AI productivity tools, music apps, and TypeScript-based web applications on GitHub.

people.name: Asoma Yuichiro
people.title: Researcher
people.bio_text: Yuichiro Asoma is a researcher at Resonac Corporation (Minato-ku, Tokyo, Japan) working at the intersection of computational chemistry and materials informatics. His published work focuses on coarse-grained molecular dynamics (CGMD) simulation and Bayesian optimization methods for refining polymer force field topologies, in collaboration with Georgia Institute of Technology researchers. He has also contributed to patent filings related to conductive polymer materials and solid electrolytic capacitors.

people.name: SAORI MIURA
people.title: researcher
people.bio_text: Saori Miura is a researcher at Resonac, a Japanese chemical and materials company focused on semiconductor and functional materials. No further public profile information could be verified from available sources.

people.name: Shiza Charania
people.title: Founder
people.bio_text: Shiza Charania is a Toronto-based founder of Haptile, coming from a mechanical engineering role at humanoid robotics company 1X. She has a background spanning biomedical imaging research, ML research on LLM sycophancy and mechanistic interpretability, and early AI innovation through The Knowledge Society, and was recognized as a Young AI Role Model of the Year in North America. She is hands-on across hardware and software, operating at the intersection of robotics, haptics, and applied ML.

people.name: Ahmad Abbas
people.title: Head of Hardware
people.bio_text: Ahmad Abbas is a veteran hardware engineer who led development of Apple's Vision Pro as Hardware Engineering Manager, and previously built hand-tracking hardware at Leap Motion alongside Midjourney founder David Holz. He joined Midjourney in December 2023 as Head of Hardware, tasked with pioneering a new category of AI-native hardware devices — likely a novel form factor distinct from existing AI wearables or pendants.

people.name: Dylan Bryan
people.title: CMO
people.bio_text: Dylan Bryan is CMO at Casey AI, a Palo Alto-based startup building scalable AI-powered career guidance to solve the endemic under-staffing of career coaching systems. He brings a background in sales (reaching #1 at Salesforce), 5 years of hands-on coaching experience, and first-hand user research with students, giving him both a GTM and domain-level lens on the edtech/career-AI space. His GitHub work on an AI Career Advisor (AI-Pathfinder-) and research-agent repos reflects a founder-level technical curiosity beyond his marketing title.

people.name: E Agor

people.title: CTO/Founder
people.bio_text: Jonah Sargent is a founder and CTO with experience launching ventures, currently at Apprend Technologies and previously at Node One. Insufficient public profile data was available to characterize his technical focus or domain convictions further.

people.name: Jamie Borland
people.title: Co-founder
people.bio_text: Jamie Borland is a co-founder of Twigg AI, a context management tool described as 'Git for LLMs' that visualizes LLM conversations as interactive trees and gives users granular control over context. The product emerged from pain points Jamie and his co-founders experienced while using LLMs during their masters at the University of Edinburgh, and launched publicly in early 2026.

people.name: Lydia Hallie
people.title: Member of Technical Staff
people.bio_text: Lydia Hallie is a software engineer, developer experience specialist, and prolific technical educator best known for her visual, in-depth JavaScript and web platform content — including a GitHub repo with 65k+ stars and multiple Frontend Masters courses. She is currently on the Claude Code team at Anthropic, where she focuses on developer experience and technical education, having previously led DX at Bun and worked as a Staff DX Engineer at Vercel. She bridges the worlds of high-quality technical content creation and product-level developer tooling, with deep expertise in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and the modern web runtime ecosystem.

people.name: Charlie Cheever
people.title: CEO
people.bio_text: Charlie Cheever is the co-founder and CEO of Expo, the open-source framework and cloud platform that powers React Native apps for 3M+ developers and has placed apps at #1 in the US App Store. Previously he co-founded Quora and was an early engineer/manager at Facebook where he built Facebook Connect and the Facebook Platform. He is deeply conviction-driven on Expo becoming the universal default for building mobile and web apps, especially as AI expands who can ship software.

people.name: Manjot Singh
people.title: CEO & founder
people.bio_text: Manjot Singh is the Founder & CEO of Ajath Infotech, a mobile app and IT consulting company founded in 2012 and headquartered in Gurugram, India, serving clients across healthcare, fintech, e-commerce, and education. With over 15 years in software development, he has led Ajath to work with 200+ businesses globally, specializing in iOS, Android, and cross-platform mobile solutions. He also holds an MBA and has a background spanning sales, marketing, and technical project management.

people.name: Era Qian
people.company: Edge (an applied AI Lab co-founded by Transformer Co-author) focusing on Edge Intelligence; Know Lukasz personally :)
people.title: Co-founder
people.bio_text: Era Qian is co-founder of Edge (EdgeAGI) and Open Source Campus, an applied AI R&D lab co-founded with Transformer paper author Lukasz Kaiser, focused on edge intelligence, sovereign AI, and open-source community building in San Francisco. She brings a rare combination of deep-tech operator instincts and institutional finance experience, having previously led digital asset investments at Matrix Capital Management and Galaxy Digital. She is a vocal advocate for on-device AI, privacy-preserving hardware, and composable open-source infrastructure, and is embedded in the frontier AI community as an organizer, emcee, and mentor.

people.name: Weiru @Creative Community
people.title: Product marketing
people.bio_text: Weiru is a product marketing professional at ByteDance, the global technology company behind TikTok, CapCut, and other content platforms. She is active in a Creative Community context, suggesting an interest in creator-focused or community-driven product marketing.

people.name: Symphony Creative Studio
people.title: PMM
people.bio_text: Product Marketing Manager at ByteDance working on Symphony Creative Studio, TikTok's AI-powered video generation and ad creative suite for advertisers. Based on the role, this person sits at the intersection of generative AI, performance marketing, and short-form video content tooling.

people.name: KSHITIJ GUPTA
people.title: Design verification engineer
people.bio_text: Kshitij Gupta is a design verification engineer at NVIDIA with a background in semiconductor IP verification, specializing in protocols such as AXI and I3C using SystemVerilog and UVM. Prior to NVIDIA, he spent approximately three years at Synopsys as a Verification IP Developer, owning the AXI Slave BFM and building checker frameworks for I3C. He is known for deep protocol expertise and strong delivery under tight deadlines.

people.name: Louan
people.title: Neuro computational scientist
people.bio_text: Louan Bardou is a neuro-computational scientist at UCSF and engineering student at École Polytechnique (MX25), based in San Francisco. His work sits at the intersection of deep learning and brain imaging, focusing on self-supervised and weakly supervised methods for fMRI analysis, white matter lesion detection, and neuroimaging segmentation. He builds applied ML pipelines—Swin UNETRs, JEPA extensions, VICReg regularization—targeting clinical neuroimaging problems.

people.name: Stiven Ding
people.title: CTO
people.bio_text: Zhiyuan (Stiven) Ding is a Computer and Data Engineering graduate serving as CTO of Braillic, a Hong Kong-based medtech startup building augmented reality surgical navigation software. His background spans software engineering, machine learning, computer vision, cybersecurity, embedded systems, and IoT, with research experience at City University of Hong Kong. At Braillic, he works on the ArNav platform, which uses AI and AR to deliver real-time 3D anatomical guidance to surgeons.

people.name: John Komarnicki
people.title: Engineering manager / National Executive advisor
people.bio_text: John Komarnicki is a technology operations manager and community leader with a background spanning cloud infrastructure, AI/ML, cybersecurity, and systems engineering. He manages engineering and IT operations at Cloudfitters, a cloud and dedicated-server infrastructure provider, while also serving as a National Executive Advisor at Code and Coffee, a large developer meetup community. His technical interests span AWS/GCP/Azure cloud platforms, agentic AI, and data-driven digital transformation.

people.name: Kaarel Kaarelson
people.title: Founding ML engineer at Known.com (raised 10 mil from Forerunner VC)
people.bio_text: Kaarel Kaarelson is an Estonian-born, San Francisco-based founding ML engineer at Known.com (a $10M Forerunner-backed consumer AI startup), focused on zero-shot ML matching problems. A self-described 10x hackathon winner, he has shipped projects spanning drone-detection CNNs, Boston Dynamics robotics infra, agentic coding tools, and AI-curated SF event discovery. He moves at exceptional speed across the ML stack and is drawn to developer tools, LLM agents, and high-leverage consumer AI applications.

people.name: JD
people.title: Founder
people.bio_text: Jaydeep (JD) is a founder and web3 builder from India who blends coding, content production, and community. He rose through the Solana/web3 India ecosystem as a core contributor at SuperteamDAO and channel producer for the Superteam Podcast and Tanmay Bhat's channel, and is now building 404s. His GitHub reflects a tinkerer who automates the weird and funny as much as the serious — from bots to smart contracts.

people.name: Artem Yatsenko
people.title: Machine Learning Engineer
people.bio_text: Artem Yatsenko is a Machine Learning Engineer at Osmosis AI with a background in ML research at Nous Research, focused on efficient inference, open-source LLMs, and transformer architectures. He is a hands-on builder whose GitHub (sumo43) spans real-time VLM inference (loopvlm, 133★), diffusion model acceleration, and minimal transformer re-implementations, reflecting a deep interest in making frontier models faster and more accessible.

people.name: wing chuen lam
people.title: Mechatronic Engineer
people.bio_text: Wing Chuen Lam is a Mechatronic Engineer at The Robot Works with prior experience at MEKA Inc., indicating a career focused on robotics hardware and systems integration. His GitHub activity is minimal (2 public repos, 1 follower), suggesting most technical work is in private or company repositories. Limited public signal is available beyond role and employer.

people.name: Jake Fitzgerald
people.title: Founder
people.bio_text: Jake Fitzgerald is a founder based in New York, affiliated with South Park Commons, who is building his first robot arm in public under the handle @soft_servo. His LinkedIn shows prior experience at AirTree Ventures building internal tools, and he is currently associated with Derive Labs. He is deeply interested in robotics, AI infrastructure, and the emerging B2A (Business-to-Agent) software category.

people.name: Shan
people.title: Director
people.bio_text: Shan is a Director at Ruyi Dynamics, the embodied AI robotics division of iMotion Technology (HK: 01274), a company focused on intelligent driving solutions and full-stack embodied AI. Ruyi Dynamics operates at the intersection of robot hardware, AI software, and deployment in industrial and commercial environments.

people.name: Grady Hannah
people.title: Co-Founder
people.bio_text: Grady Hannah is a medical device entrepreneur and software veteran who co-founded NightWare, an FDA-cleared AI-powered wearable therapeutic for PTSD-related nightmare disorder, and led it from inception through FDA breakthrough designation and commercialization into the VA and DoD. With 15 years in Silicon Valley's simulation and gaming industry before pivoting to digital health, he brings an unusually cross-disciplinary lens to regulated AI products. He is now co-founder of RAMHT (Rapid-Acting Mental Health Treatment), a platform convening innovators at the frontier of fast-acting psychiatric care.

people.name: Lisa Wang
people.title: Founder
people.bio_text: Yun Wang (Lisa Wang) is a serial founder and XR/AI/Robotics strategist based in San Francisco, currently building at the intersection of extended reality, enterprise AI infrastructure, and industrial automation. She previously led AR enterprise strategy at Xreal and now runs RL Smart Solutions and a stealth AI startup, delivering bespoke XR, digital twin, and robotics consulting to government agencies, automotive manufacturers, and global industrial clients. Her background spans brand strategy, digital marketing, and PR, giving her a rare blend of technical depth and go-to-market experience.

people.name: Sharon
people.title: Partner
people.bio_text: Sharon is a Partner at TheAgentic.Ai, a company building production-ready AI agent infrastructure for industries where accuracy is critical — including biotech, healthtech, cybersecurity, and fintech. Their GitHub activity reflects a background in PHP-based developer tooling, including TYPO3 ecosystem utilities, based in Germany.

people.name: Allen Xu
people.title: Exec Assistant
people.bio_text: Allen Xu is an Executive Assistant at Build AI. No additional public signal was recoverable from their X (@allenbuilds) or LinkedIn (linkedin.com/in/allenjxu) profiles at the time of enrichment.

people.name: Georgi
people.title: Founder
people.bio_text: Georgi Boby is the founder of Rilo, an AI-powered GTM automation platform that helps startup teams replace manual sales and marketing workflows with multi-agent systems. An IIT Bombay electrical engineering alumnus and ex-CloudChef operator, he is deeply hands-on — running global hackathons, judging builder events, and actively hiring for execution-focused GTM roles. He is based in the San Francisco Bay Area and is focused on making agentic workflow automation the default for early-stage teams.

people.name: Tom Zhanh
people.title: Founder
people.bio_text: Tom Zhang (Hanwen) is the founder of Ruyi Dynamics, a robotics company. Insufficient public data was retrievable from his X (@iMotionai) or LinkedIn profiles to characterize his background, prior roles, or technical convictions in detail.

people.name: Dev Aggarwal
people.title: Founder & CTO
people.bio_text: Dev Aggarwal is the Co-Founder & CTO of Gooey.AI, a low-code AI orchestration platform enabling developers and teams to build, share, and measure generative AI workflows across multiple models. Based in Seattle, he is passionate about building abstractions and applying AI for real-world impact in emerging markets, particularly India and Africa. He also co-founded Dara.Network, a community networking platform, and is actively hiring software engineers.

people.name: Wāñg Çhūãñfū
people.title: CEO
people.bio_text: Wang Chuanfu is a Chinese chemist-turned-entrepreneur who founded BYD Company in 1995 and built it into a Fortune 500 conglomerate spanning electric vehicles, batteries, rail transit, and electronics — now the world's largest plug-in EV manufacturer. He spends 60–70% of his time on technology and product development and has long bet that EVs would allow China to leapfrog internal combustion engine development entirely. Backed by Warren Buffett's Berkshire Hathaway since 2008, he is widely regarded as one of China's most influential business leaders.

people.name: Ming Guo
people.title: Chief Scientist and Co-founder
people.bio_text: Ming Guo is the Co-founder and Chief Scientist of ZKM, where he leads development of zkMIPS/Ziren — a universal zero-knowledge virtual machine built on the MIPS32r2 ISA, designed for verifiable computation far beyond blockchain. With a career spanning aerospace, computer graphics, chip architecture (MIPS), and blockchain (co-founding Metis in ~2017), Ming is a deeply philosophical engineer who frames ZK not merely as a scaling tool but as the foundation for an 'internet of trust' and a self-sustainable decentralized economy (DAC Economy). He recently co-founded Laz AI to explore the convergence of zero-knowledge proofs with artificial intelligence.

people.name: Parth Behani
people.title: Robotics Hardware Test Engineer
people.bio_text: Parth Behani is a Robotics Hardware Test Engineer at Tesla, working on the TeslaBot (Optimus) humanoid robot program. He has been with Tesla across both an internship and a full-time role, accumulating hands-on experience in mechanical and hardware testing for humanoid robotics. With a career starting around 2018 and spanning multiple companies, he brings broad exposure to hardware engineering in the robotics space.

people.name: Saurabh Khire
people.title: AI Engineer
people.bio_text: Saurabh Khire is an AI Engineer at HiJenny AI and MSCS graduate of Cleveland State University with a background spanning backend development, Android, and ML. He has shipped projects spanning AI agents, founder matchmaking tools, and vibe-coding extensions, reflecting a focus on applied AI and developer tooling. His GitHub footprint spans Python, JavaScript, and TypeScript, with early-stage work in agentic and LLM-adjacent tooling.

people.name: Alex Kreidler
people.title: Software Engineer
people.bio_text: Alex Kreidler is a software engineer currently at Mercor, an AI-powered talent marketplace, with interests spanning Linked Data, ML, web tech, and DevOps tooling. He has built open-source data infrastructure projects and written extensively about ML developer tools and recommendation systems. He is drawn to cutting-edge technology that solves real problems.

people.name: Colin Nebius
people.title: dev advocate
people.bio_text: Colin Lowenberg is an engineer, entrepreneur, and ecosystem builder with 20 years of experience spanning wireless networking, Web3 developer relations, and AI infrastructure. Currently Developer Advocate at Nebius, he bridges the gap between cutting-edge GPU cloud infrastructure and the builders who use it, while also running Dabl.Club, SF's independent builder community. His background spans Accenture, Cisco, Consensys, and hands-on agentic AI tooling built on top of Nebius.

people.name: Anders Lie
people.title: Co-founder/CTO
people.bio_text: Anders Lie is a repeat YC founder (S25) and CTO based in San Francisco who specializes in bringing AI-native developer tools from zero to one. He co-founded Sagekit (an AI-native Zapier alternative) and Magnitude (an open source coding agent for open source models), and previously ran Lie Software as a fractional CTO practice focused on LLM integrations and early-stage product development. His background spans full-stack engineering, AWS identity systems, and agentic AI infrastructure.

people.title: Supply Chain Analyst
people.bio_text: Shreyas Khatav is a supply chain and project management professional currently working as a Supply Chain Analyst at Saint Gobain, holding a Master's from the University of Denver's Daniels College of Business. His background spans hospitality, sales & marketing, and supply chain analytics, with a demonstrated interest in data-driven operations and project management methodologies like Agile and Kanban.

people.name: Rick Uzcategui
people.title: Founder
people.bio_text: Ricardo Uzcategui is the Co-Founder, CTO, and COO of Pangian, a global remote talent platform connecting professionals across 150+ countries, which he has been building since 2016. A Techstars mentor and TED AI alum based in San Francisco, he operates at the intersection of AI/ML, Web3, and the future of work, with a core conviction that geography should never be a barrier to career opportunity. He actively helps startups grow and advises on remote hiring, talent ecosystems, and early-stage company building.

people.name: Dzianis
people.title: Software Engineer
people.bio_text: Dzianis (Den) is a software engineer at Coinbase based in the Greater Seattle Area, educated at the Belarusian State University of Informatics and Radioelectronics. He has hands-on experience with blockchain and web3 engineering, and has built open-source tools including a Firebase-backed password manager. His Medium bio self-describes as 'yet another tech guy.'

people.name: Arpan Desai
people.title: Co-founder
people.city: Ahmedabad, India (also active in San Francisco / US market)
people.bio_text: Arpan Desai is a serial founder and fintech builder who co-founded MobileFirst Applications in 2014 and pivoted it into Fintegration, a specialist fintech product engineering firm with 100+ engineers serving clients across the US, UK, and India. He is also Co-Founder/CTO of SportsFirst, a sports-tech company with NFL team customers, and brings 14+ years of experience spanning mobile development, fintech API integration, AI orchestration, and enterprise consulting at PwC. Arpan is deeply embedded in the FinTech, SportsTech, and LegalTech ecosystems across India and the US.

people.name: Shant Lokmanian
people.title: Partner
people.bio_text: Shant Lokmanian is a Los Angeles-based co-founder of Fenderr Freight, a carrier identity verification and onboarding platform designed to prevent double brokering and freight fraud. He has prior experience across several companies including Centum Inc., VALID Technologies, Chase, and The Pickle. Specific role details and technical background are not publicly visible.

people.name: Pranav Patel
people.title: Student
people.bio_text: Pranav Patel is a Northeastern University student and enthusiastic full-stack developer who builds AI-powered applications aimed at solving real-world problems. His GitHub spans healthcare AI, DAO tooling, geoscience ML, and agentic systems, primarily in Python, JavaScript, and TypeScript. He is driven by a vision of making lives easier through technology, with particular interest in LLM fine-tuning, open-source tooling, and applied AI.

people.name: Sid Dedhia
people.title: Lead PM
people.bio_text: Sid Dedhia is a Lead PM at Verkada, focused on building video monitoring products within the world's largest cloud-based B2B physical security platform. He is based in San Francisco and has 500+ LinkedIn connections. Background includes education at Carnegie Mellon University's Mountain View campus.

people.name: Prajyot Patil
people.title: Robotics Engineer
people.bio_text: Prajyot Patil is an ML/Robotics Software Engineer at Meta with a background spanning manipulation, mobile robotics, and sim-to-real learning pipelines. She holds a degree from Santa Clara University and has hands-on experience with Isaac Sim, ROS 2, VSLAM, and Learning from Demonstrations frameworks including BC-GMM. Her work bridges academic research and industry application across humanoid and mobile robot platforms.

people.name: Asmita Hajra
people.title: AI Researcher
people.bio_text: Asmita Hajra is an AI researcher with a rare blend of deep technical research and business acumen, holding an MS in AI from Carnegie Mellon and an MBA from University of Chicago Booth. She has moved through roles at Grant Thornton, Google (Payments Data Science), Cisco Systems (AI Research), and most recently NVIDIA (Research Scientist, Post-Training), where she focuses on aligning and optimizing large language models. Her research spans multimodal AI, generative models, and responsible AI, and she is a public advocate for ethical AI practices.

She convenes roundtables for vertical AI founders spanning healthcare, real estate, automotive, and veterinary sectors, and is known for her conviction that founders must start with hidden demand before building product. Her background spans cultural/talent catalysis, relationship marketing, and internet community building, with a longstanding presence in the SF Bay Area tech scene.

EZswap was founded by builders from major NFT marketplaces and has raised funding from EOS Network Foundation, IOBC Capital, and MT Capital.

people.name: Jamie Cerexhe
people.title: CTO
people.bio_text: Jamie Cerexhe is the Co-Founder and CTO of Mastt, an agentic AI platform for construction project management that he co-launched in 2019 and has grown to support 500+ projects worth over AU$25 billion. A Forbes 30 Under 30 Asia honoree (Enterprise Technology, 2021) and PMI Future 50 awardee (2022), Jamie leads a global engineering team with a strong conviction that AI agents should handle repetitive project delivery work so humans can focus on higher-order decisions. Before Mastt, he held senior roles at Contentserv, ran coding bootcamps at Coder Academy, and contributed digital skills programs for the United Nations.

people.name: Jakob Kaiser

people.bio_text: Jakob Kaiser is a Robotics Software & Data Engineer at New Theory. His work sits at the intersection of robotics software systems and data engineering.

He has published at top venues including CoRL 2024, RAL, and IJRR, with a focus on geometric deep learning applied to robotic manipulation. His LinkedIn activity highlights a strong conviction that structured, hierarchical approaches to robot learning can dramatically reduce data requirements.

people.name: Ahmad Ali
people.title: During my time leading HEC IA, I recognized a recurring challenge in fostering interdisciplinary collaboration for AI projects. Traditional academic structures often silo students by their primary fields, hindering the cross-pollination of ideas essential for innovative AI solutions. To overcome this, I "hacked" the conventional student organization model by implementing a structured, project-based team formation system that actively prioritized diversity in academic backgrounds and skill sets. Instead of allowing self-selection based on existing friendships or superficial interests, we developed a matching algorithm that considered complementary technical skills, domain expertise (e.g., business, ethics, design), and individual learning objectives. This wasn't a computer hack in the literal sense, but a strategic re-engineering of how human capital was organized and deployed within our community. The advantage gained was significant: projects developed within these diverse teams consistently demonstrated higher levels of innovation, practical applicability, and a more holistic consideration of societal impact, directly aligning with the mission of HEC IA to push the boundaries of AI responsibly. This approach not only enhanced the quality of our output but also created a more dynamic and enriching learning environment for all participants.
